training.negative_selection: Highest binary objectness loss among negative cells, independently per frame; all positive cells retained
training.selection: First highest localization F1 on original plus frozen spatial validation frames

interpretation: Hard-negative mining greatly improved precision on the reused development captures, but shifted/scaled test recall and F1 declined slightly. This is not uniformly improved generalization.
limitations: Captured results are reused, correlated draft-geometry development examples from one session
Only one training seed and no independently collected captured-table audit for this detector
Unknown layouts/scales, clutter, occlusion and backgrounds remain unvalidated
Card roles, whole-table state, calibrated confidence and coaching activation remain unresolved
next_work: Freeze this detector/recognizer pair, gather independently reviewed table captures and test scale/spacing failure cases before integration or readiness claims
